description: This source file defines the RuntimeMessagingTrace class, which handles logging and tracing of message dispatching events within the Orleans runtime, including warnings, errors, and informational logs related to message forwarding, rejection, deadlocks, and other dispatcher-related activities.

classes.name: RuntimeMessagingTrace
classes.description: A sealed class that extends MessagingTrace to provide detailed logging and tracing for message dispatcher activities in Orleans runtime.

methods.name: OnDispatcherReceiveInvalidActivation
methods.description: Logs and handles the event of receiving a message with an invalid activation state.

methods.name: OnDispatcherDiscardedRejection
methods.description: Logs and processes the event when a message rejection is discarded with a specific reason.

methods.name: OnDispatcherRejectMessage
methods.description: Logs and processes the event when a message is rejected, including rejection details.

methods.name: OnDispatcherForwarding
methods.description: Logs and manages the forwarding of a message from one address to another.

methods.name: OnDispatcherForwardingFailed
methods.description: Logs when forwarding a message fails.

methods.name: OnDispatcherForwardingMultiple
methods.description: Logs the forwarding of multiple message requests to a destination address.

methods.name: OnDispatcherSelectTargetFailed
methods.description: Logs when selecting a target for message delivery fails, including error filtering logic.
